q1.question: The extension button isn't appearing on a form
q1.answer: Some websites use JavaScript to render forms dynamically. Try scrolling down to trigger the page to fully load, then look for the ⚡ button. If it still doesn't appear, email us with the URL of the site.

q2.question: Gemini Nano says "Not supported on this device"
q2.answer: Gemini Nano requires Chrome 127+ and sufficient device RAM (typically 8GB+). You can still use the extension by adding your own API key in Settings (Bring Your Own Key). OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, and OpenRouter are all supported.

q3.question: My profile isn't saving
q3.answer: Go to the extension's Options page (right-click extension icon → Options). Make sure you've clicked Save after entering your profile. If it still doesn't save, try the Troubleshoot button on the Options page.

q4.question: The AI-generated answer doesn't sound like me
q4.answer: The AI uses your profile to generate answers. Fill in the Bio and Experience fields with detail — the more context you give it, the better the output. You can always edit any answer before submitting.

q5.answer: In Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, find Donbrico Autofill AI, click Remove. All your profile data will be deleted automatically.

q1.question: The extension toolbar isn't appearing on a page
q1.answer: Make sure you're on a page with a text field (input or textarea). Click inside the field first — the AI Reply toolbar should appear near the field. If it doesn't, refresh the page and try again.

q2.question: My saved replies aren't showing up
q2.answer: Check that you've saved replies in the Library tab of the extension popup. If you recently re-installed, replies stored locally are gone unless you exported a backup (Pro feature).

q3.question: Gemini Nano says 'Not supported on this device'
q3.answer: Gemini Nano requires Chrome 127+ with sufficient RAM (typically 8GB+). You can still use the extension by adding your own API key in Settings (Bring Your Own Key). Supported providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, OpenRouter.

q4.question: AI-generated replies sound generic or off-topic
q4.answer: The AI uses the text field's context plus your selected tone. For best results, use specific prompts and set a detailed tone. If using a BYOK provider, try switching to a different model.

q5.question: How do I uninstall and remove my data?
q5.answer: In Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, find Donbrico AI Reply Assistant, click Remove. This deletes all locally stored replies and settings.

q6.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
q6.answer: Email support@donbrico.net with 'Bug:' or 'Feature Request:' at the start of your subject line.

q1.question: How do I save a workspace?
q1.answer: Click the extension icon to open the popup, then click 'Save Current window' or 'Save All Windows'. AI will suggest a name, or you can type your own.

q2.question: Can I restore workspaces on another computer?
q2.answer: Yes, if you use the 'Export as JSON' feature (Pro) to backup your data and import it on your other device.

q3.question: What happens if I delete a workspace?
q3.answer: Deleted workspaces are gone forever. However, you can use the 'Archive' feature to hide workspaces without deleting them.

q1.question: The extension toolbar isn't appearing on Airbnb or Vrbo
q1.answer: Make sure you're on the messaging inbox page. Refresh the page if the toolbar doesn't appear.

q2.question: Host Memory details aren't being used in replies
q2.answer: Check that you've saved your property details in the Host Memory tab of the extension popup.

q1.question: Why does the model download take so long?
q1.answer: On the first run, FileWhisperer AI downloads highly-optimized Llama-3 models (~2-4GB) to run completely offline. Depending on your internet speed, this might take several minutes, but once downloaded, you'll never need an internet connection again.

q2.question: What file types are supported?
q2.answer: Currently, FileWhisperer AI supports PDF documents (.pdf), rich text (.rtf), Word documents (.docx), text files (.txt), markdown (.md), and Excel/CSV spreadsheets.

q1.question: The OCR engine skipped some items on my receipt
q1.answer: Extremely blurry scans, crumpled paper, or handwriting can lower OCR accuracy. Try straightening the receipt and scanning under good lighting. You can always manually double-click any parsed field to edit values directly.

q2.question: How do I backup my expense data?
q2.answer: Go to Settings in the application and click 'Export Expense Vault'. This exports a self-contained database backup (.db) along with all categorized receipt images in a single ZIP archive.

q1.question: My video file is taking too long to transcribe
q1.answer: High-definition video files can take longer to load. MeetingWhisperer AI automatically extracts the audio track first to save resources. Check your system's hardware acceleration in Settings — selecting CUDA (NVIDIA) or DirectML can speed up Whisper by up to 5x.

q2.question: How do I improve speaker identification?
q2.answer: Local speaker diarization works best when speakers do not overlap or interrupt frequently. You can name detected speaker profiles (e.g. 'Speaker 1' -> 'Alice') in the audio transcript editor to update the names globally.

header.intro: Gemini Nano is built directly into Chrome on supported hardware. When it works, your AI completions run entirely on your device — free, instant, and never leaving your machine.

note.title: Note:
note.text: Gemini Nano runs on your device, so it can be slower than cloud-based AI providers. For faster responses, consider using a Bring Your Own Key provider like Groq (free tier available) or OpenAI.

enable.title: Enable Gemini Nano in Chrome
enable.intro: Gemini Nano and the Prompt API are experimental features. You need to enable two Chrome flags and then download the model before it will respond to requests.

step1.title: Open Chrome flags
step1.text: Type the following into your Chrome address bar and press Enter:

step2.title: Enable the Prompt API flag
step2.text: Search for Prompt API for Gemini Nano in the flags search box, then set it to Enabled.
step2.desc: Enables the window.ai JavaScript API so extensions can interact with Gemini Nano.

step3.title: Enable Optimization Guide (model download)
step3.text: Search for Enables optimization guide on device and set it to Enabled BypassPerfRequirement. The bypass option allows download even on lower-spec hardware.
step3.desc: Allows Chrome to download the Gemini Nano model to your device.

step4.title: Relaunch Chrome
step4.text: Click the blue Relaunch button that appears at the bottom of the flags page, or close and reopen Chrome completely.

step5.title: Trigger the model download
step5.text: After relaunching, navigate to the components page to force Chrome to download the Nano model:
step5.text2: Find Optimization Guide On Device Model in the list and click Check for update. The download may take several minutes depending on your connection. The model is approximately 20 GB.

enable.warn: The model download happens silently in the background. Chrome must be open and connected to the internet. Once downloaded, it stays on your device permanently.

verify.title: Verify it's working
verify.intro: Once the model is downloaded, you can confirm everything is set up correctly without leaving Chrome.

devtools.title: Quick test via DevTools
devtools.text: Open any webpage, press F12 (or right-click → Inspect → Console), and paste this snippet:

results.title: The console output means:
results.readily: "readily" — Gemini Nano is downloaded and ready. You're all set.
results.afterDownload: "after-download" — Chrome knows about the model but it's still downloading. Wait and try again in a few minutes.
results.no: "no" — The model isn't available on this device. Check the troubleshooting section below.

verify.tip: Once you see "readily", open the Donbrico Autofill AI extension popup. The AI status indicator in settings should show Gemini Nano · Active.

console.title: The console returns "no" or throws an error
console.text: Go back through the steps above and confirm both flags are enabled (not just one). Then relaunch Chrome again and wait 5–10 minutes before retesting. Chrome sometimes delays initialising the API even after the flags are set.

components.title: chrome://components shows no version for the model
components.text: Make sure you're signed into Chrome with a Google account. In some regions, the model is gated behind a Google account sign-in. Also ensure Chrome is not running through a VPN or proxy that blocks Google's download servers.

stuck.title: The model download is stuck
stuck.text: Visit chrome://components, find the Optimization Guide model, and click Check for update again. If it remains stuck, try restarting Chrome and checking for updates once more.

requirements.title: My machine meets requirements but it still shows "no"
requirements.list1: Confirm you're on Chrome version 127 or later (check chrome://version).
requirements.list2: Some enterprise-managed Chrome installs block experimental flags. Check with your IT team.
requirements.list3: Ensure Chrome has at least 22 GB of free disk space to store the model.
requirements.list4: Try disabling and re-enabling both flags, then relaunching.

fallback.title: What happens if it doesn't work?
fallback.text1: Donbrico Autofill AI gracefully falls back to your Bring Your Own Key API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, or OpenRouter) whenever Gemini Nano isn't available. You'll never be left without AI completions.
fallback.text2: If neither Gemini Nano nor an API key is configured, the extension will show a friendly prompt guiding you to set one up. You can always add an API key in the extension's settings panel.
fallback.tip: Need an API key? See the API Keys guide to get one from OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, or OpenRouter in under 5 minutes.
